text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nikkeeeei! New Year's hiiiigh!
High, high, hiiiigh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her first target race of the Senior Year, the Nikkei Shinshun Hai.
Mejiro Palmer's hype was off the charts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Man, I figured I'd just go full-on party animal from start to finish today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it... Until last year,
I was doing everything half-heartedly, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'd get scared midway through and end up just watching how things played out. That's why today—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna cut loose and go all out! Going full throttle from the start is my style, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In this first graded race of the year,
Mejiro Palmer seemed to be betting on a complete image change.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's nail that paddock entrance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Bestieee! Let's goooo☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayyy☆ Stick to the plan and go for it!
Palmer-chin is totally unbeatable today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she had already conveyed her enthusiasm to Daitaku Helios.
And so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The time has finally come to get totally hyped up—right here in the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Mejiroooo!! Wooooo-hoooo☆

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(N-Naturally they'd be taken aback.
It's not like any Mejiro Umamusume has ever
greeted someone with "Mejiro, yaaay☆" before.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I'm gonna do it. I'll see it through to the end.
At my own pace!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
How're the vibes, everyone!?
Super high key, or totally major bummer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If you're feeling down in the dumps, I'll turn it right around in the race! Don't you dare underestimate the party vibes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Boring races are totally lame, right? Who needs 'em?
Mejiro Palmer doesn't give a damn
about common sense!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I promise to make it a blast, so count on me!
Cheer loud, yell loud, and follow me during the race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get super hyped up!
The most pumped-up Mejiro you've ever seen, whoo—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Oooohh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A faint reaction came back. Half the fans
were still completely flabbergasted. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that should do for now.
Though some of the fans still haven't gotten into the groove...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The real show starts now! I'll hype everyone up with my running!
Watch me, Trainer!
